_schema: Phase-1 standalone kernel optimization QUEUE (kept ready). Per authored kernel: regime, root cause of the roofline gap, ranked optimization levers (DONOR-FIRST: reuse OneDNN/cpublas/library primitives; author only the missing glue), realistic achievable target across the M-sweep, the hard no-regression floor vs torch, and the correctness gate. STATUS=PLANNED until implemented + measured on the TARGET node (perf numbers below are the UNOPTIMIZED baseline from SLURM 384414). Ordered by F7 ROI. Each pass is F4-gated (tie_eps=0 / cosine+relerr) and ends with a per-op roofline-target-vs-measured record. Phase-1 is complete only when ALL kernels meet the bar, then PAUSE FOR REVIEW before Phase-2 integration.
baseline_record: SLURM 384414 (results/perf_sweep.json); nominal EMR BW 358 GB/s, AMX 125 TF, FP32 7.8 TF
f4_gate: plugin/validate/f4_acceptance.py (tie_eps=0 selection; cosine+relerr continuous; sparse-AMX experimental)
donor_first_rule: Use existing OneDNN / ATen cpublas (brgemm/pack/bmm, oneDNN-backed) / MKL / vectorized-exp primitives wherever they exist; AUTHOR only the irreducible missing glue (epilogue, dispatch, tiling, fusion). Never hand-roll a matmul a library already provides.

kernels.root_cause: N-only parallelism starves cores @ small M; per-tile HEAP Cbuf alloc churn (~32-64us @M1); bf16 conversion is N-serial; adaptive tiling makes 64 tiny brgemms @M1; branchy relu epilogue.
kernels.donor: GEMM already uses ATen cpublas brgemm + VNNI pack (oneDNN/MKL-backed) — KEEP. Optimize only the glue.
levers_ranked: thread-local Cbuf reused across tiles (all M, top ROI)
M=1 dispatch path (S-parallel / library bmm, bypass tiling)
cap Sb larger at small M (fewer, better-amortized brgemms)
branchless std::max relu + aligned SIMD epilogue
fuse/caller-side bf16 conversion
kernels.no_regression: dispatch to torch.bmm at any M where cpp>torch (M=1/8 may tie torch — acceptable, never slower)
kernels.correctness: keep FP32-accumulated scores; tie_eps=0 induced-selection must stay 0 mismatches (already conformed to BF16 oracle)

kernels.root_cause: two-stage chunked selection retains every chunk element before merge; S/k=2 chunk cap gives <=2 first-stage tasks at small M; per-row overhead.
kernels.donor: std::nth_element (libstdc++) is the selection primitive — KEEP; no OneDNN topk donor.
levers_ranked: one-stage row selection at small M (vs two-stage), preserving set-match + tie semantics
reduce per-row alloc
best-of dispatch chunked(large N)/row(small N)

target.note: already fast in absolute terms; target = hold no-regression floor + shave small-M overhead

kernels.regime: BW-bound but running at ~7.1% of the BW-ideal -> upstream (grain/exp/dispatch) bottleneck, NOT the DRAM wall
kernels.coverage_gap: ONLY R=128/D=512 measured; R=8/D=512 and R=8/D=128 (the bulk of call-weight) UNMEASURED -> ADD benches before 'done'
kernels.root_cause: N-only at::parallel_for leaves cores idle at small N; 2 std::exp per channel per window; dispatch grain.
kernels.donor: no library softmax-pool donor; use a vectorized/approx exp (SVML/oneDNN eltwise) as the donor primitive for the exp hot path.
levers_ranked: parallelize over N*D tiles (fill all cores, not N-only)
vectorized/polynomial exp (2 exp/channel/window is the hot path)
channel-tiling for cache residency
measure R=8 shapes (REQUIRED)
kernels.no_regression: >= torch at every M + every shape
kernels.correctness: masked -inf handling (F1) intact; online-softmax reassoc within cosine>=0.999999/relerr<=1e-4

kernels.regime: BW-bound; scalar wins small M (3.55x @M1) but LOSES at large M (tie @M64); per-query AMX fails (M-dim=1)
kernels.root_cause: scalar online-softmax uses no AMX; AMX variant tiles a 1x512 contraction (dispatch tax) and differs in bf16 rounding.
kernels.donor: ATen at::bmm (oneDNN/MKL GEMM) is the donor for the AMX path — batch N*H into the GEMM M-dim.
levers_ranked: CORRECT BF16-conformant AMX path: reinterpret [(N*H)xK]@[KxD], FP32 softmax+sink fused, bf16 weights for the output GEMM (matches the published BF16 primitive)
best-of dispatch scalar(small M)+AMX(large M), crossover ~M12-16
K/topk coverage 128/640/160 real dispatch

target.M32/M64: AMX path to beat torch, close the 6.5x gap

kernels.no_regression: dispatch guarantees >= torch at every M (scalar floor small M, AMX large M)
kernels.correctness: AMX path EXPERIMENTAL until it conforms to the published kernel.py BF16 primitive (F4 sparse oracle); do NOT accept AMX as a looser class; full 128/640/160 coverage + the donor-MLA-flash dispatch question are prerequisites to 'sparse Phase-1 done'

kernels.regime: DISPATCH/latency-bound tiny op — the FLOP roofline is the WRONG ceiling; caption the realistic dispatch floor

baseline_off_roofline.note: 2389x @M1 but ABSOLUTE 2-15us; already near the dispatch floor

kernels.root_cause: 86 calls/token x ~2us launch overhead dominates; useful compute ~1-2us; already fused (20 iters in one C++ loop).
kernels.donor: no library donor (custom eps-regularized recurrence); keep fused.
levers_ranked: adjacent fusion sinkhorn->combine (both MHC, 86 calls each)
serial-vs-parallel threshold to avoid thread-team spinup at tiny sizes
batch across layers if the caller allows

target.note: likely near realistic floor; target = no-regression + dispatch-grain reduction; publish FLOP-roofline CAPTIONED as unreachable

kernels.no_regression: >= torch at every M (serial-threshold at tiny sizes)
kernels.correctness: cosine pre/post/comb; eps placement/reassoc across 20 iters within tolerance

kernels.root_cause: near DRAM-BW saturation at large M; tiled accumulate-once already good; gap @small M is dispatch.
kernels.donor: no library donor (custom hc weighted-sum); keep tiled accumulate.
levers_ranked: adjacent fusion with sinkhorn (shared MHC path)
serial-threshold at small M
verify tile fits L1 across shapes
kernels.correctness: cosine+relerr; reduction order (currently bit-exact vs einsum oracle, max_err=0)

phase1_exit: ALL kernels implemented + optimized across the M-sweep (and KV knob) with per-op roofline-target-vs-measured recorded AND the no-regression floor vs torch held at every M; compressor R=8 pools measured; sparse AMX conformed or dispatched. THEN PAUSE FOR REVIEW. Only after review -> Phase-2 proxy integration (correctness + progressive wall-time extrapolation).
